content.short: UniLend Finance is a multichain lending and borrowing protocol for all ERC20 tokens.
content.description: DeFi today suffers from fragmentation, with many protocols offering lending and borrowing for only a limited set of tokens. UniLend bridges this gap by enabling any ERC20 asset to be used as collateral for lending and borrowing. The protocol includes features such as Isolated Dual Asset Pool, Non-Fungible Tokenisation, Concentrated Liquidation, Permissionless listing, and Flash Loans.

resources.title: Isolated Pools for Any Token Pair
resources.tldr: Dual asset pools mean one volatile asset cannot damage the whole protocol, which is the trade-off against shared-pool lending.
